summary: ICICI Bank filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing of $1 billion in senior unsecured fixed-rate notes under its $7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme. The notes carry a 5.459% coupon, mature July 30, 2031, and are listed on the India International Exchange, NSE IFSC, and SGX-ST. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
